schema.text: Do you have difficulty seeing or hearing, even with glasses or a hearing aid?
schema.help: We ask this so that the study also counts the barriers met by people who find getting around more difficult.

en.#We ask this so that the study also coun: We ask this so that the study also counts the barriers met by people who find getting around more difficult.
en.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Do you have difficulty seeing or hearing, even with glasses or a hearing aid?

it.#We ask this so that the study also coun: Lo chiediamo perché lo studio tenga conto anche degli ostacoli che incontra chi fa più fatica a spostarsi.
it.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Hai difficoltà a vedere o a sentire, anche con gli occhiali o con un apparecchio acustico?

fr.#We ask this so that the study also coun: Nous posons cette question pour que l’étude tienne compte aussi des obstacles rencontrés par les personnes pour qui se déplacer est plus difficile.
fr.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Avez-vous des difficultés à voir ou à entendre, même avec des lunettes ou un appareil auditif ?

de.#We ask this so that the study also coun: Wir fragen dies, damit die Studie auch die Hindernisse erfasst, auf die Menschen stoßen, denen das Unterwegssein schwerer fällt.
de.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Haben Sie Schwierigkeiten beim Sehen oder Hören, auch mit Brille oder Hörgerät?

tr.#We ask this so that the study also coun: Bunu, ulaşımda daha fazla zorlanan kişilerin karşılaştığı engellerin de çalışmada dikkate alınması için soruyoruz.
tr.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Gözlük veya işitme cihazı kullansanız bile görmekte ya da duymakta zorluk çekiyor musunuz?

fa.#We ask this so that the study also coun: این را می‌پرسیم تا موانعی که افرادِ دارای دشواری در رفت‌وآمد با آن روبه‌رو می‌شوند نیز در مطالعه دیده شود.
fa.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: آیا حتی با عینک یا سمعک در دیدن یا شنیدن مشکل دارید؟

hu.#We ask this so that the study also coun: Azért kérdezzük, hogy a vizsgálat azokat az akadályokat is figyelembe vegye, amelyekkel a nehezebben közlekedők találkoznak.
hu.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: Nehezére esik a látás vagy a hallás, akár szemüveggel vagy hallókészülékkel is?

ar.#We ask this so that the study also coun: نسأل عن ذلك حتى تأخذ الدراسة في الحسبان أيضًا العوائق التي يواجهها من يجدون صعوبة أكبر في التنقل.
ar.#Do you have difficulty seeing or hearin: هل تجد صعوبة في الرؤية أو السمع، حتى مع النظارات أو المعينات السمعية؟
